name: 53mp – Fast Bulk Page Creator
author: a 53 minute production

sections.description:
53mp – Fast Bulk Page Creator adds 53mp Tools → Bulk Create in wp-admin. Paste or type a simple indented list and create an entire page tree in one step.

Each line is a page title. Optional slugs go in parentheses, for example About Us (about). Use Tab and Shift+Tab (or spaces) to nest child pages under the line above.

You can set shared options for every page in the batch: status, visibility, author, date, template, menu order, excerpt, and discussion settings. Choose an existing parent page to attach top-level rows from your outline.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the 53mp-fast-bulk-page-creator folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate 53mp – Fast Bulk Page Creator through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open 53mp Tools → Bulk Create.
  4. Enter your page structure, adjust options, and click Create pages.
sections.faq:
Does this replace the block editor or classic editor?

No. It only creates empty pages (no block content). Edit each page afterward as you normally would.

Can I create pages under an existing parent?

Yes. Use Create these pages under to pick a parent. Top-level rows in your outline become children of that page.

Does this plugin collect or send data?

No. It does not call remote services, track usage, or store settings in the database beyond a short-lived admin notice transient after you submit the form.
